decided: workspace-5f4: ci-go.sh's fmt scan logic is CORRECT and stays untouched; the fix is auditability — every run now prints the resolved root it scans, so a wrong-tree invocation is visible in the transcript instead of silently green. workspace-53y: the commit/PR-title convention gains ONE multi-id form — space-separated ids inside the existing parens, '(workspace-a workspace-b)' — comma forms remain rejected, the 100-byte cap is unchanged.
why: 5f4 was root-caused by direct repro: the exact pre-fix otlp_test.go from PR #106 (commit cb45c90) IS flagged by ./scripts/ci-go.sh fmt locally — same go1.27.0/gofmt as CI, tested in both the repo checkout and an agent worktree (exit 1, file printed twice: nested-module pass and root recursive pass). The reported local green therefore cannot have run against a tree containing that content; worktree agents inherit absolute parent-repo paths, making a wrong-tree run the one remaining explanation, and today the script's output does not say which root it scanned, so that mistake is undetectable after the fact. 53y: one canonical separator keeps every downstream consumer trivial — ids remain extractable as /workspace-[a-z0-9.]+/g regardless of count — and a single-space separator costs the fewest bytes under the cap.
cost_if_wrong: 5f4: if a genuine scan bug exists that this session failed to reproduce, the divergence recurs — but the new root line then localizes it to a tree and a run immediately, which is exactly the evidence PR #106's incident lacked. 53y: if the space-separated form proves awkward, the regex alternation is one line to amend and every already-merged single-id title stays valid; the risk of a too-loose regex admitting garbage is pinned by new negative test cases.
alternatives: 5f4: rewrite the fmt walk to iterate git ls-files per module — rejected: changes a mechanism proven correct on an unreproduced theory
5f4: trap-based diagnostics dumping env on failure — rejected: heavier, same visibility for more surface
53y: comma-separated ids — rejected: a second separator byte per id and a wider char class; this script's history (byte-vs-char cap) argues for minimal syntax
53y: accept both comma and space — rejected: two canonical spellings of one convention is exactly the drift review-charter item 8 exists to prevent
53y: leave titles single-id and rely on PR bodies — rejected: the founder's bundling instruction makes the squash header the audit record on main, and it should name every bead it closes
scope: scripts/ci-go.sh (one output line), scripts/commit-lint.sh (regex alternation + usage text), scripts/commit-lint-test.sh (new positive/negative cases), CONTRIBUTING.md (convention wording). Gate-surface edit, sanctioned because both tracked items are explicitly CI/policy items.
